Tarnobrzeg New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Tarnobrzeg, Poland

Not demolished. This is the newer of Tarnobrzeg's two Jewish cemeteries, likely established before 1860, the year Rebbe Eliezer Horowitz of Dzików — progenitor of the Dzików Hasidic dynasty — died and was buried here; an ohel was erected over his grave, and his successors were buried there as well. The cemetery was destroyed during WWII, with its wall, ohel, and trees removed. In 1966, descendants of the Tarnobrzeg Hasidic dynasty erected a new ohel with plaques commemorating four rabbis, their wives, and their daughters.
